package config

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestLoadAcceptsOptionalHTTPHost(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("HTTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
	cfg, err := Load()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if cfg.HTTPHost != "127.0.0.1" {
		t.Fatalf("HTTPHost = %q", cfg.HTTPHost)
	}
}

func TestValidateRejectsSharedInboundAndStagingTokens(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := Config{
		HTTPPort: 8094, Environment: "test", DatabaseURL: "postgres://example",
		InternalAPIToken: "shared", AIPromptURL: "http://ai", AIPromptToken: "ai",
		LearningPlannerURL: "http://learning", LearningPlannerToken: "learning",
		SandboxURL: "http://sandbox", SandboxToken: "sandbox",
		ValidationURL: "http://validation", ValidationToken: "validation",
		PracticeURL: "http://practice", PracticeStagingToken: "shared",
	}
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "must be distinct") {
		t.Fatalf("expected distinct-token validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateRejectsNamedDevelopmentDefaultsInProduction(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := Config{
		HTTPPort: 8094, Environment: "production", DatabaseURL: "postgres://example",
		InternalAPIToken: "change-me-tz-planner-api", AIPromptURL: "http://ai", AIPromptToken: "ai",
		LearningPlannerURL: "http://learning", LearningPlannerToken: "learning",
		SandboxURL: "http://sandbox", SandboxToken: "sandbox",
		ValidationURL: "http://validation", ValidationToken: "validation",
		PracticeURL: "http://practice", PracticeStagingToken: "practice",
	}
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "default internal tokens") {
		t.Fatalf("expected production default-token validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}
